text:
elaine: Heads-up: preparing the joint marketplace/press checklist. Need final vendor embargo windows + any region capacity notes so we can finalize SKU pairing and routing fallbacks. Target: finalize by Thu EOD.

sam: Quick question: should H200 be treated as a separate SKU family if memory configs differ? That affects SKU tags and migration logic.

diego: Yes — ops preference is distinct SKU if memory != drop-in compatible. Vendors, confirm expected memory configs for H200 and MI300 variants. @vendor-nvidia @vendor-amd

vendor-nvidia: H200 expected configs: 80GB and 160GB variants. Recommend treating them as separate SKUs. Nvidia embargo window for H100/H200 announcements: 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-25. H100 capacity limited in eu-west for first week.

tara: Noted on eu-west constraint. Marketplace request: please provide canonical SKU names we can lock into our catalog. We prefer short, consistent tags.

oliver: Draft SKU proposal (suggested): rw:gpu:h100:48g:v1, rw:gpu:h200:80g:v1, rw:gpu:h200:160g:v1, rw:gpu:b200:32g:burst:v1, rw:gpu:mi300:1024g:v1, rw:gpu:gaudi:64g:v1. Open to tweaks.

vendor-amd: MI300 ETA: 2026-05-28 GA. Embargo: 2026-05-20 -> 2026-05-29. We'll ship a stability driver on 2026-05-22 that fixes long-sequence hang. No region capacity constraints at GA.

diego: Ops routing rule draft: Enterprise SLA tiers -> prefer H100/H200 variants by region, fallback order: compatible MI300 variant -> Gaudi family -> B200 (burst). For memory-incompatible requests, fall back earlier.

sam: CI ask: add a short job to simulate memory-mismatch fallback (request pinned to 160GB model but H100 only has 48GB) and verify that sessions failover cleanly with clear error and no silent truncation.

elaine: Action items: 1) Vendors to confirm embargo text (done). 2) Marketplace (tara) to lock SKU tags and publish mapping to the partner repo. 3) Eng-runtime (diego) to add memory-mismatch and capacity-fallback CI jobs. 4) Comms (sam) to draft joint-announce timeline + 72h internal freeze. Due: Thu COB.

release-bot: [notice] Canary window tentatively 2026-05-27T01:00:00Z 1:00:00Z for fallback and driver sanity checks.

oliver: I'll update the spec with the SKU tags and include a note that H200 may need separate pricing tiers. I'll send PR to marketplace repo once tags are confirmed.

elaine: Thanks everyone. If any vendor has last-minute embargo language changes, post them here immediately. We9ll lock the announce doc after vendor sign-off. :white_check_mark:
